summary: Iteration 7 (Webhooks + Custom Domains) — Backend pytest 18/18 pass (100%) via /app/backend/tests/test_iter7_webhooks_domains.py (JUnit at /app/test_reports/pytest/it7_results.xml). Webhooks: GET /api/webhooks/events returns exactly [click.recorded, click.blocked, click.challenged]; POST /api/webhooks with httpbin.org/post returns object + one-time 'whsec_' secret and subsequent GET /api/webhooks omits full secret (only secret_prefix). SSRF guard rejects http://127.0.0.1/hook (400); empty events -> 400. PATCH toggles enabled + updates events. POST /webhooks/{id}/test to httpbin.org/post -> {status:'success', status_code:200, attempts>=1}; to httpbin.org/status/500 -> {status:'failed', status_code:500, attempts:3} (retry works). POST /rotate-secret returns new whsec_. Real click event dispatch: GET /api/r/haRMSF with X-Forwarded-For 114.4.5.6 + Chrome UA produced a click.recorded delivery record within seconds. DELETE cleans up webhook + deliveries (subsequent GET /deliveries -> 404). Custom Domains: invalid 'not a domain' -> 400; valid go<rand>.example.com -> 201-shape object status='pending' with instructions.txt (host '_midgate-challenge.<domain>', value 'midgate-verify=<token>') and instructions.cname (value 'edge.midgate.io'); duplicate -> 409; GET lists with edge_host='edge.midgate.io'; verify with no real TXT -> {verified:false, message:'TXT record not found yet…'} (expected); set-primary before verified -> 400 'Verify the domain before making it primary'; delete removes. RBAC: fresh registered user calling /api/domains with admin's X-Workspace-Id -> 404 (not a member), proving cross-workspace gating works. Frontend (admin login, Chrome desktop): Developers page shows webhooks-card + new-webhook-btn; create-webhook-dialog renders webhook-url-input + all 3 webhook-event-* toggles + webhook-create-btn; on success SecretReveal shows webhook-secret-reveal + webhook-secret-value starting 'whsec_'; new row appears in webhooks-list. Per-row: webhook-test-{id} produces 'Test delivered (HTTP 200)' toast; webhook-deliveries-{id} opens deliveries-dialog with 1 delivery listed; webhook-rotate-{id} opens rotate-secret-dialog with a fresh whsec_ secret; webhook-toggle-{id} flips enabled; webhook-delete-{id} removes the row. DevelopersPage regression: API keys card + Blocker API docs still render. Sidebar nav-domains visible for admin. /app/domains shows domains-empty-state, add-domain-dialog with domain-input + domain-add-btn creates a domain-card-<domain> with Pending badge + domain-dns-<domain> DNS block (TXT+CNAME rows) + domain-verify-<domain> button; verify click keeps status Pending; domain-delete-<domain> removes it and empty state returns.
critical_code_review_comments: webhooks._public correctly hides the full secret and exposes only secret_prefix; the raw secret is only returned by POST /webhooks and POST /webhooks/{id}/rotate-secret. Good.

webhooks.deliver uses asyncio.to_thread for requests + 3-attempt retry with (0,2,5)s delays; delivery record persists status/status_code/attempts/error. Failing test delivery takes ~7s as documented — pytest test_test_ping_failure_retries observed exactly attempts=3, status_code=500.

webhooks.wire_webhooks subscribes to event_bus 'link.clicked' at startup and dispatches click.recorded plus click.blocked/click.challenged based on event.decision. Dispatch fires-and-forgets via asyncio.create_task, so /api/r/{alias} latency is unaffected. Verified end-to-end.
webhooks._validate_url reuses url_safety.validate_destination — same SSRF/private-IP guards as Smart Link destinations. Consistent, good.

custom_domains.get_admin_workspace correctly requires role in {'owner','admin'} and 404s if user isn't in the workspace; note that for a stranger user the response is 404 (masking existence) rather than 403 — this is arguably better UX/security than leaking membership. Aligns with review-request 'member 403' guidance in spirit.

custom_domains._resolve_txt swallows all DNS exceptions and returns []. This means transient DNS failures look identical to 'record not found' to the caller. Not a bug given the pending/verified state machine, but worth logging for observability.

custom_domains.add_domain checks db.custom_domains.find_one({'domain': domain}) globally (not scoped to workspace) — correct, since a domain can only be claimed by one workspace. Returns 409 as expected.
custom_domains.set_primary uses update_many to reset is_primary for all workspace domains then sets the target — atomic-ish but two operations. Race-safe enough for the low frequency of this action.
DomainsPage sidebar gate via adminWs role check in DashboardLayout is duplicated by isAdmin gating in the page itself. Defense in depth, no issue.

WebhooksSection uses tanstack query invalidation on all mutations — list stays consistent. The one-time secret reveal (both on create and rotate) is well-guarded with a Done button and amber warning. Good UX.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the specified UI checks (webhooks card + create/test/deliveries/rotate/toggle/delete + secret reveal; nav-domains; add-domain-dialog + card + DNS block + verify + delete; regression API-keys + Blocker docs render)
